title: JurisdictionScanReport
description: Output schema for the jurisdiction-scan tool. Describes every external dependency and service contact point found in a repository, annotated with risk levels.

repo.description: Absolute path to the scanned repository root.

cloud_providers.description: Cloud providers detected in the repository (e.g. aws, azure, gcp).

saas_endpoints.description: SaaS domain names detected in any scanned file.

github_actions.description: True when at least one GitHub Actions workflow file is present (.github/workflows/). Kept for backwards compatibility; see ci_platforms for full CI detection.

ci_platforms.description: CI/CD platforms detected in the repository.

gitlab_ci.description: GitLab CI (.gitlab-ci.yml or gitlab-ci keyword) detected.

circleci.description: CircleCI (.circleci/ path or circleci.com reference) detected.

container_registries.description: Container registry hostnames referenced in any scanned file.

cdn_dns.description: CDN and DNS provider identifiers detected (e.g. cloudflare.com, route53).

secrets_management.description: Secrets management service identifiers detected (e.g. vault, secretsmanager, azure-keyvault).

terraform_providers.description: Terraform provider identifiers found in provider blocks within .tf files.

dependencies.description: Dependency manifest filenames found in the repository (e.g. requirements.txt, package.json).

findings.description: Files grouped by detection category. Keys are category names; values are sorted arrays of absolute file paths.

risk_summary.description: Risk annotation for each finding group that has at least one hit. Keys are either a top-level field name (e.g. cloud_providers) or a category-prefixed name (e.g. category:Identity).

risk.description: Risk level for this finding group.

count.description: Number of distinct items or files in this group.
